viewing_check: Look for a maker's plate or casting name (on the wheel covers, column or table), motor plate (HP, phase; 3-phase lowers resale), wheel diameter and throat size, whether the table tilts and wheels are intact and not cracked, and ask for it to be powered up. Photograph the plate and the motor.
